I fixed this in `packages/injected/src/roleUtils.ts` (around line 749). I haven't built or run anything, and I didn't add a test.

The embedded-control branch of the accessible name computation only contributed a value when the role was `textbox`. An `<input type="search">` has the `searchbox` role, so it skipped that branch and its value was dropped. The condition now reads `role === 'textbox' || role === 'searchbox'`.

A search input now contributes its value to the name the same way a text input does. That covers both a button named through `aria-labelledby` and a search input inside a `<label>`.
